c4.creator: Blender3D
c4.decision: Integrated from the verified owner-provided Simple Old C4 archive once the creator and CC BY 4.0 metadata were checked.

alternate.creator: Charlie Tinley
alternate.decision: Preferred original-format visual. Creator states that they authored the model and textures. Anonymous download returned HTTP 401. Archive and terms remain pending.

smoke.creator: Roman Berezyak
smoke.decision: Integrated from the owner-supplied original archive. The nested RAR supplied one FBX with intact colour, roughness, metallic, AO and distinct OpenGL and DirectX normal maps.

alternate.decision: The CC BY listing and description use different resale terms. Hold pending clarification.

claymore.creator: Aleksandr Goncharov
claymore.decision: Excluded because the provider metadata lists a noncommercial licence. The project exterior uses its own game-scene envelope.

shield.creator: local.yany
shield.decision: Rejected for fit. A vertical hand shield would change the silhouette of the existing waist-high cover slab.
